**Management Summary – Project LV 147,957 €**

A critical discrepancy of €12,285 exists between the printed total and summed positions, indicating missing or deleted items that must be reconciled. Several medium‑risk gaps affect scope clarity and compliance: site‑establishment (2.1.1.10), asphalt base and wearing courses (2.1.3.80, 2.1.3.90), shaft construction (2.1.2.50), concrete exposure data (2.1.2.70), waterproofing (2.1.3.50), insulation (2.1.3.40), and homogeneous ground area (2.1.1.40). Low‑risk omissions involve detailed specifications for paving, masonry, screed, plaster, and waste disposal. Immediate actions: (1) audit and correct the LV total; (2) request missing technical data and clarify scope for all medium‑risk items; (3) update contractual documents to prevent risk transfer. Resolving these issues will secure cost accuracy, regulatory compliance, and risk mitigation.
